newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: NSA announces 200 million rand unbundling.
newsitem.headline: NSA announces 200 million rand unbundling.

text.p: NSA Investments Ltd said on Thursday it would unbundle its holdings in Education Investment Corp Ltd (Educor) and Housewares Group Ltd worth about 200 million rand to its shareholders subject to their approval.
It said the unbundling was part of its strategy to dispose of holdings in listed companies where it could not add value and its holdings were low.
NSA currently holds 10 percent of Educor and 16 percent of Housewares.

"The unbundling, which involves shares with a total value of of about 200 million rand, is in line with NSA's policy of distributing shares in freely traded listed companies where NSA's role is limited and where its holding has fallen below its desired percentage," the company said in a statement.
NSA shareholders would receive approximately 22 Housewares shares and 24 Educor shares for every 100 NSA shares held on the last day to register for the unbundling.
NSA chief executive Leornad Fine said all their major shareholders were in favour of the transaction.
The unbundling would also allow NSA option holders to chose whether to participate in the unbundling or not. At present options are convertible in September 1997.

In order to qualify for the unbundling the option strike date would be brought foward to March 1997 and the strike price would be reduced by the time value of the money, about 40 cents per option, from the new exercie date to the current one (September 1997).

Those option holders who do not want to participate would be compensated for the reduction in the value of the company. The strike price of the option on exercise date would be reduced by the value of the distribution on the last day to register (currently around two rand per NSA share), the company said.
Fine said as a by-product of the distribution NSA would have the potential for future deals without expanding the company to an unwieldy size.

"We will be receiving approximately 90 million rand from the exercise of the options and have the capacity for gearing. We are actively looking for new investments to replace Educor and Housewares without increasing our share capital," Fine said.
